assumptions.claim: Seven physical-service exchange phases and six digital-review phases are authored task abstractions, not paper protocol text.
Synthetic fixture has one job per branch and one bookkeeping specimen or digital package; it does not represent actual material quantities or experimental replication.
Aggregate readout branches intentionally require all four in situ source-run records to review the paper-level comparison.
No symbolic pose, parameter, source result or fixture state grants operational authority.
